//: Internship Autopilot — root package. V1 runs as a single Next.js app plus background workers, per spec section 30.
name: internship-autopilot

scripts.//dev: Start the Next.js dashboard in development mode on http://localhost:3000
scripts.//build: Compile the production build (also type-checks the whole app)
scripts.//lint: Static analysis via Next's built-in ESLint config
scripts.//typecheck: Type-check without emitting files — fast feedback in CI
scripts.//test: Unit tests for the pure logic (normalization, dedupe, eligibility, scoring)
scripts.//db: Database lifecycle — Prisma owns the schema and migrations
scripts.//scan: Run the continuous scanner (spec §5). Add --once for a single cycle.
